Pir Muhammad Amin-ul-Hasnat Shah also highly appreciated the political, social, democratic and religious services of Chairman Senate Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani. He said that Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani had made valuable contributions to the promotion of democracy, constitutional values and the development of the country, which would always be remembered with respect and appreciation. Grok 4.6 is my daily driver now. This is why: When I’m using interactive agents in a CLI/terminal (or even Slack), what matters most to me is speed & token throughput. Intelligence and differences in performance on benchmarks is negligible to me when speed is sacrificed. If I am there to steer & guide the agent, or make some quick fixes, then I don’t want to wait 5+ min per turn. Opus 5 (fast) is a good solution to this, but it is WAY too expensive. Grok 4.6 is perfect though, incredibly fast, almost as smart as Fable, and relatively much cheaper than anything else right now. On the flip side, for cloud agents working in Factories & background tasks triggered on crons, I don’t mind using intelligent, slow models like Fable / Sol. I’d even opt for a model router for cloud tasks that biases to heavy, smart models. I guess the meta point I’m making here is that model choice is largely a function of whether there’s a human waiting in the loop.

Now that I’ve had a little time to reflect on DEF CON 34, I think what stays with me most isn’t actually standing on the stage. It’s the people. Of course, seeing a full house at Recon Village while talking about something I care deeply about - OSINT, critical thinking, and the cognitive consequences of relying too heavily on AI - was incredibly special. But walking around DEF CON afterwards and having people stop me just to say hello, tell me they enjoyed the talk, challenge an idea, or continue the conversation… That genuinely meant a lot to me. I got to reconnect with old friends and somehow leave Vegas with a whole bunch of new ones. And I got to spend several days surrounded by hackers, researchers, investigators, builders, curious minds and people who simply look at the world differently. That’s probably what I’ll remember most. I came to DEF CON to share some of my thoughts. I’m leaving having had my own thinking challenged and expanded in return. And perhaps that’s exactly what a gathering like DEF CON should do. So thank you DEF CON and Recon Village for having me. Thank you to everyone who came to the talk. And especially thank you to everyone who stopped me somewhere along the way just to talk, laugh, share an idea, grab a drink or say hello. I’m humbled, grateful, slightly exhausted, and leaving with far more ideas than I arrived with. DEF CON, you’ve been an absolute blast. I’ll be back. P.S. I will re-record my talk I gave at DEFCON and post this on my Github/Youtube. Please have a little patience with that. It will be online soon. #defcon34 #reconvillage #osint #ai @defcon @ReconVillage

اطلاعات روز: برآورد شما از عمق یا میزان آسیبی که سیاست‌های طالبان در حوزه آموزش به توسعه‌ی اجتماعی، اقتصادی و فرهنگی افغانستان می‌رسانند، چیست؟ اکثر کسانی که دانایی را توانایی می‌دانند، فرض‌شان این است که علم‌ستیزی طالبان به افغانستان آسیب می‌زند. اما در بسیاری موارد، این افراد مصداق‌های ملموس این آسیب را نمی‌توانند عرضه کنند. چند نمونه از این آسیب‌ها را در حوزه‌های مختلف نشان بدهید. بلخی: من کاملا با این گفته موافقم که «دانایی توانایی است»؛ همان‌گونه که نیای خردمند ما گفته است: «توانا بود هر که دانا بود». به یاد دارم که در جریان تدوین طرح اصلاحات دهه معارف، وقتی روی فلسفه‌ی آموزشی افغانستان کار می‌کردیم، به این جمع‌بندی رسیدیم که سیاست آموزشی آینده‌ی کشور باید بر «تربیت و تعلیم» استوار باشد؛ به‌دلیل همین، آگاهانه «تربیت» را پیش از «تعلیم» آوردیم. برداشت ما این بود که تعلیم، تولید دانایی است، اما این دانایی زمانی معنا و کارکرد پیدا می‌کند که در خدمت تربیت انسان قرار گیرد. از این منظر، قابلیت، مهارت و ظرفیت سه شاخص اصلی توانایی‌ اند؛ توانایی یعنی ظرفیت مدیریت خود، محیط و جامعه در عرصه‌های اجتماعی، اقتصادی، بازار کار، حکومت‌داری خوب و سایر حوزه‌های زندگی جمعی. نظام آموزشی افغانستان وظیفه داشت این قابلیت‌ها را از طریق یک «نصاب قابلیت‌محور» به نسل دانش‌آموز منتقل کند. اما امروز این هدف در سیاست‌گذاری و اهداف اصلی آموزشی طالبان جایگاهی ندارد. بنابراین، آنچه از خروجی نظام معارف زیر سلطه‌ی طالبان انتظار می‌رود، نسلی عاطل، فاقد قابلیت، بی‌بهره از مهارت و محروم از ظرفیت‌های لازم برای زندگی در جهان معاصر است. حال تصور کنید چنین شهروندی به کدام‌یک از نیازهای افغانستان می‌تواند پاسخ دهد؛ و تصور کنید در سده بیست‌ویکم، در جهانی که با توسعه‌ی علمی، فناوری و هوش مصنوعی پیش می‌رود، ملتی را داشته باشیم که از قابلیت‌های مدرن محروم ساخته شده است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259295

افسرخان احمدزی، ۳۰ ساله و باشنده کابل، به دلیل ورود غیرقانونی دوباره به ایالات متحده امریکا، پس از اعتراف به جرم به ۵۱ روز زندان محکوم شد. بر بنیاد اعلامیه دفتر دادستان ایالات متحده امریکا در حوزه شمالی نیویارک، آقای احمدزی اعتراف کرده است که در سوم جون ۲۰۲۶، با عبور پیاده از مرز بین‌المللی در نزدیکی شامپلین، نیویارک، از کانادا وارد ایالات متحده شده و از بازرسی مقام‌های مهاجرتی و گمرکی امریکا اجتناب کرده است. او پس از ورود، از سوی ماموران گشت مرزی امریکا بازداشت شد. این پرونده از سوی گشت مرزی ایالات متحده بررسی و توسط تروی اندرسون، معاون دادستان ایالات متحده، پیگیری شده است. #طلوع‌نیوز

PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement on August 7. Reports indicate that the 3 countries have in essence agreed to a NATO Article 5-like clause—an attack on one signatory would be considered an attack on all of them. The agreement "reflects a change underway in the Middle East's regional order—one that reduces the United States' decades long leadership role," writes expert @stevenacook. The U.S.-aligned order could now become a Middle East with two blocs: the countries that remained committed to the Abraham Accords—the 2020 normalization agreements between Israel and Bahrain, Morocco, and the UAE—and its alternative, the Mecca Agreement, he argues. "Previously, regional rivalries and disputes were contained because leaders prioritized their relations with the United States, which was the tie that bound the regional order. Now, with the Pakistanis, Saudis, and Turks moving forward with a vision that competes directly with the Abraham Accords, that no longer seems to be the case," he writes. Ambedkar Konaseema, Andhra Pradesh: A fishing boat carrying eight fishermen has gone missing after venturing into the sea from Odalarevu in Ambedkar Konaseema district, triggering concern among their families. The boat, owned by Kopanati Ramakrishna Varma of Komaragiri Patnam village in Allavaram mandal, left the jetty at Odalarevu on August 3 through the Vainateya river-sea confluence for fishing. The fishermen had reportedly carried provisions and diesel sufficient for around 15 days and were expected to return by August 13. However, the boat failed to return as scheduled, and there has been no communication from the fishermen. Their mobile phones and the GPS system installed on the boat are also reportedly not functioning. After the boat failed to return even four days after the expected date, the owner’s family informed the Coastal Security Police at Odalarevu and the district authorities. Konaseema District Collector R. Mahesh Kumar sought assistance from the Indian Coast Guard in Visakhapatnam to trace the missing boat and rescue the fishermen. Preliminary information suggests that the boat may have travelled towards the Visakhapatnam–Paradip coastal region for fishing. The Fisheries Department confirmed that eight fishermen, including boat owner-cum-driver Kopanati Ramakrishna Varma, were on board. The Collector directed Fisheries Department officials to immediately coordinate with the Indian Coast Guard for search and rescue operations. He also instructed officials to coordinate with District SP Rahul Meena and collect all available information from the boat owner, family members, and other fishermen, and share it with the Coast Guard and other concerned rescue agencies. The Collector directed officials to continuously monitor the situation and immediately communicate any information regarding the whereabouts and safety of the fishermen to the district administration: Konaseema District Collector R. Mahesh Kumar

L’adhésion d’Haïti à la CAF ouvre de nouvelles perspectives de coopération et de financement pour la mise en œuvre de projets structurants et d’initiatives de développement au bénéfice de la population haïtienne. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MAE_Haiti/status/2089433265224704219#m

Today, our High-Level Inter-American Delegation to #Haiti held productive discussions with Haitian authorities, led by Prime Minister @PrimatureHT Alix Didier Fils-Aimé @citoyendidier, the Minister of Foreign Affairs @MAE_Haiti, members of the Cabinet, and other national authorities, on the path forward for Haiti. A central focus of our discussions was the urgent need to advance preparations for elections. Restoring elected institutions is essential to Haiti’s democratic future and to creating the stability and confidence needed for the country’s recovery. Security and sustainable development are critical to that effort and must advance alongside the electoral process. We reaffirmed the commitment of the @OAS_official to supporting Haitian-led efforts toward credible, inclusive, and peaceful elections, with full respect for Haiti’s sovereignty and leadership. In particular, we discussed the importance of accelerating the preparation of the electoral registry and strengthening civic information campaigns so that the largest possible number of Haitians can exercise their right to participate. The #OAS stands ready to provide technical cooperation throughout the electoral process and, when the time comes, electoral observation. Security remains fundamental to making elections possible. We recognize the efforts underway to strengthen Haiti’s national institutions, particularly the Haitian National Police @pnh_officiel and other national security actors. These efforts include the P4000 program supported by the U.S. @StateDept’s Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs @StateINL. The OAS is contributing through complementary initiatives, including Forward Operating Bases, capacity-building for the HNP, and cooperation with the judicial police to strengthen capabilities to trace illicit financial flows. Lasting stability will require sustained international support alongside stronger Haitian capabilities and effective coordination. Our conversations also underscored that Haiti’s democratic recovery must deliver hope and opportunity for its people. The participation of the Inter-American Development Bank @the_IDB, CAF – Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean @AgendaCAF, and the World Bank @WorldBank allowed us to explore initiatives supporting Haiti’s longer-term development. Education, healthcare, job creation, and economic opportunity cannot wait. They are priorities now. We also discussed strengthening coordination among international partners, development banks, the private sector, and regional organizations to better align our collective support with Haiti’s priorities. The objective that brings these efforts together is clear: helping create the security, institutional, and social conditions that allow Haitians to choose their representatives through credible elections and move toward a more democratic, stable, and prosperous future. The Inter-American community stands in solidarity with the Haitian people and remains committed to accompanying Haiti on that path. #OASwithHaiti

I'm, again, not particularly concerned by reports about the US Navy having been asked to move the island on the future carriers for "aesthetic reasons". I'm not saying I don't believe Trump can have said something about that; he absolutely might have. But I feel pretty confident in assuring you that the Navy is thinking about potentially moving the island again not because of Trump, but because of plenty of good or potentially good reasons. The still image I've attached here is CAPT Tal Manvel (Ret), who was the Program Manager who led the design work for the FORD class carriers as they are today, showing a number of design ideas / iterations that were considered during the process. This is Design 5 and was, he always mentions it, the "ideal" design they had landed upon, in many ways. The FORD as finally settled was in some ways a cut down / revision of Design 5. You see that white rectangle right up front...? That was where the Island was going to be. Tal Manvel and his team originally wanted the island there, but listened to contrarian observations and ultimately moved it aft. They had earlier looked at having the island bang in the literal middle, with two angled decks, one on either side. They also considered a more central positioning of the island, not just down the lenght of the ship, but inward on the deck as well, to have a super "alaska highway" outboard of the island enabling aircraft movement well clear of the runway. CVA-01 style, in concept (not in detail, of course). They also clipped off the stern corners of the flight deck because they listened to LSOs who said, with practical (but questionable) wisdom that if the deck was made full width at the back, sooner or later someone would park aircraft there, and cause trouble during landing ops. They preferred taking the deck extensions off entirely rather than risk that. All options have merits and defects, and there is nothing to say the current position is "the best". It's literally just the compromise that was selected at the time, very good for some things, not so great for others. It is, again, not heresy to say the future carriers might change the island positioning again. I assure you it's one of the many things they'll always look at. And while a President's wish might be added to the list of considerations, i do not think for a moment it will be the one that drives the thinking. My choice remains not to subscribe to the hysteria unless there are good reasons to be worried. At present, I do not feel there are good reasons.

سے زیادہ پریشان کر رہی ہے وہ ہے ان کی ذہنی دباؤ اور اضطراب کی کیفیت ہے، دل کی دھڑکن میں بے ترتیبی، اور بڑہتا ہوا بلڈ پریشر۔ رپورٹ میں نیند کی کمی کا ذکر نہیں، مگر ادویات دیکھ کر یہ بھی تقریباً یقینی لگتا ہے۔ میں عمران خان کو 35 سال سے زیادہ عرصے سے جانتا ہوں۔ ذہنی دباؤ کبھی ان کی کمزوری نہیں رہا۔ مگر اب یہ عروج پر ہے، خود بتا رہا ہے کہ تین سال کی قید اور مکمل تنہائی نے ان پر کیا اثر ڈالا ہے۔ اس کی وجوہات سمجھنا مشکل نہیں: ملک کی صورتحال، جیل میں مقید ساتھی، شہید ہونے والے اور ان کے سوگوار خاندان۔ خود ان کی اپنی تنہائی، نہ اخبار، نہ کتابیں، باہر کی دنیا سے مکمل بےخبری۔ اور بلاشبہ بشریٰ بی بی، اپنی بہنوں، کارکنوں اور پارٹی کے بارے میں ان کی فکرمندی۔ دوائیوں کو دیکھیں، کیونکہ تشخیص تو موجود ہی نہیں۔ انہیں Citani اور Lexotanil دن میں تین بار دی جا رہی ہیں۔ یہ نیند کی کمی کا علاج نہیں۔ یہ دن کے وقت کے اضطراب کا علاج ہے۔ ان کی دل کی دھڑکن 54 فی منٹ ہے۔ ڈاکٹر اسے "نارمل" کہیں گے۔ لیکن ان کے لیے یہ نارمل نہیں۔ ان کی آرام کی حالت میں دل کی دھڑکن ساری زندگی 40 کی دہائی کے ابتدائی ہندسوں میں رہی ہے، جو ایک تاحیات فٹ کھلاڑی کی نشانی ہے۔ 54 تک پہنچنا ایک تبدیلی ہے۔ ا نہوں نے دل کی دھڑکن میں بے ترتیبی کی شکایت کی ہے۔ یہ ایسی بات نہیں جسے نوٹ کر کے نظرانداز کر دیا جائے۔ اس کے لیے فوری طور پر 24 گھنٹے کے لیۓ ہولٹر مانیٹر لگانا ضروری ہے، تاکہ اس کی تعداد معلوم ہو اور صحیح دوا تجویز کی جا سکے۔ یہاں تک کہ پاکستان سے باہر رجسٹرڈ ایپل فون سے منسلک ایپل واچ بھی Atrial Fibrillation اور دھڑکن کی بے ترتیبی کو حقیقی وقت میں ظاہر کر سکتی ہے (کیونکہ یہ فیچر پاکستان میں غیر فعال ہے)۔ اب وہ بلڈ پریشر کی تین الگ الگ دوائیں لے رہے ہیں۔ اس کے لیے روزانہ صبح و شام باقاعدہ نگرانی درکار ہے تاکہ خوراک درست کی جا سکے، ہفتہ وار اندازوں پر نہیں چلا جا سکتا۔ انہیں کولیسٹرول کم کرنے والی دوا بھی دی جا رہی ہے۔ اس عمر میں بڑھا ہوا کولیسٹرول جینیاتی اور ذہنی دباؤ دونوں وجوہات سے ہو سکتا ہے، اور اسے خوراک، ورزش اور دوا کے امتزاج سے قابو کرنا ضروری ہے، جیسا کہ بلڈ پریشر کے لیے بھی۔ کم نمک۔ زیادہ حرکت۔ حقیقی نگرانی۔ درج ذیل ٹیسٹ اب بغیر کسی مزید تاخیر کے ہونے چاہئیں: ۱) اسٹریس ٹیسٹ ۲) ایکو کارڈیوگرام ۳) کارڈیک ایم آر آئی ۴) Cardiac Artery Calcium CAC اسکین — بڑھے ہوئے کولیسٹرول کی وجہ سے، تاکہ شریانوں میں جمع کیلشیم کے ذخائر معلوم ہوں جو براہِ راست دل کے دورے یا اسٹنٹ کی ضرورت کا باعث بنتے ہیں۔ ۵) کارڈیک سی ٹی انجیوگرام اور، اگر ضرورت پڑے تو، دیگر ٹیسٹ۔ میں سخت پریشان ہوں۔ تنہائی ان کے جسم پر جسمانی اثرات مرتب کر رہی ہے۔ اگر اسے فوری طور پر حل نہ کیا گیا تو نقصان ناقابلِ تلافی ہو سکتا ہے۔ عمران خان کو اب فوری طور پر ہسپتال کے ماحول میمنتقل کیا جانا لازمی ہے، ایک آزاد اور غیرجانبدار طبی بورڈ کی نگرانی میں۔ ان کا خاندان اور پاکستان کے سرکاری ڈاکٹروں پر بلکل اعتماد نییں کرتے ہیں۔ سب پہلے بھی دیکھ چکے ہیں کہ رپورٹس میں ردوبدل کیا گیا، اعداد و شمار بڑھا چڑھا کر یا دبا کر پیش کیے گئے، پلیٹلیٹس کا معاملہ اس کی ایک مثال ہے۔ اگلے تین ماہ بہت اہم ہیں اور پتہ چلے گا کہ ان کی حالت بہتر ہوتی ہے یا VIDEO | Delhi: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched ‘Delhi Ko Kude Se Azadi, Swachhta Abhiyan 2026,' a city-wide cleanliness campaign that will be conducted across the national capital from August 17 to October 2, 2026. Addressing the gathering, Chief Minister Gupta called upon government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens to actively participate in the campaign through Shramdaan and collective action. She said the campaign will focus on cleanliness drives across public spaces, source segregation of waste, reduction of single-use plastic and promotion of the 3R principle (Reduce, Reuse and Recycle). Chief Minister also announced that the best-performing wards will receive an incentive of Rs 1 crore in recognition of their outstanding cleanliness efforts, and appealed to every Delhiite to make cleanliness a part of everyday life. The launch programme was attended by Delhi BJP President and Union Minister of State Harsh Malhotra, Cabinet Minister Ashish Sood, MCD Mayor Pravesh Wahi, MLA Abhay Verma, along with senior officials, public representatives and other dignitaries. Pir Muhammad Amin-ul-Hasnat Shah also highly appreciated the political, social, democratic and religious services of Chairman Senate Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani. "সুপার কাপের আদলে চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ দিয়ে মৌসুম শুরুর কথা ছিল, তবে সেটি বাতিল করেছে বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল ফেডারেশন (বাফুফে)। ম্যাচটিতে খেলার কথা ছিল গত মৌসুমের বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগ ও ফেডারেশন কাপ চ্যাম্পিয়ন বসুন্ধরা কিংস ও লিগ রানার্সআপ আবাহনীর। তবে ফিফা নিষেধাজ্ঞার কারণে এখনও ফুটবলার নিবন্ধন শুরু করতে পারেনি এই দুই দল। যে কারণে বাতিল হয়েছে চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ। সোমবার (১৭ আগস্ট) বিকেলে বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগের ক্লাবগুলোর সঙ্গে বৈঠক শেষে ২১ আগস্ট নির্ধারিত চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ আয়োজন না করার বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেছেন বাফুফে সভাপতি তাবিথ আউয়াল। তিনি জানান, ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের প্রক্রিয়া শেষ করার জন্য আজ রাত পর্যন্ত সময় দেওয়া হচ্ছে। এরপর পরিস্থিতি পর্যালোচনা করে পরবর্তী সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া হবে। তাবিথ আউয়াল বলেন, ‘২১ আগস্ট চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ মাঠে গড়াচ্ছে না। আজ ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের শেষ দিন। আমরা আজ রাত পর্যন্ত অপেক্ষা করব। এরপর সিদ্ধান্ত নেব। ফেডারেশন কাপ ও লিগ পূর্বঘোষিত সূচি অনুযায়ী শুরুর ইচ্ছা আছে।’ সভায় বসুন্ধরা কিংসের পক্ষ থেকে কোচ গোলাম জিলানী আরও সাত কর্মদিবস সময় দেওয়ার অনুরোধ জানিয়েছেন। তার প্রত্যাশা, এই সময়ের মধ্যেই ফিফার দেওয়া দলবদল নিষেধাজ্ঞা উঠে যাবে। নিষেধাজ্ঞা প্রত্যাহার হলে ক্লাবটি ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের আবেদন করার সুযোগ পাবে এবং এরপর খেলোয়াড় নিবন্ধনও করতে পারবে। বর্তমান সূচি অনুযায়ী, আগামী ২৫ আগস্ট মাঠে গড়ানোর কথা ফেডারেশন কাপ। এর তিন দিন পর, ২৮ আগস্ট শুরু হওয়ার কথা বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগ। আর চলতি দলবদল কার্যক্রম শেষ হবে ৩ সেপ্টেম্বর। #BangladeshFootball #BashundharaKings #Abahani #somoytv

In Budapest, a rock has resurfaced in the Danube. It's called the Rock of Starvation - Ínség-szikla. For centuries, its return has meant one thing: the river is so low the mills fall silent, crops fail, and hunger follows. It surfaced in 1616. In 1718. In 1811, 1830, 1842, 1868. In 1947. And now it's back, in 2026. For the first time in 44 years, Hungary has shut down all but one of its Danube-cooled nuclear reactors. A nearby farmer puts it plainly: "I've lost nearly 50% of my harvest, and it could hit 70%. Since I started farming after the end of communist rule, I've never seen a catastrophe like this." The rock is a warning. It's been delivering it for 400 years. We know exactly what it says, but we haven't been listening.

Hear this fascinating story first hand in my interview with the MiG-25 Foxbat pilot in question who flew target mapping missions over Kargil: youtu.be/dH9JiRtuW18?si=dPpX… Anchit Gupta (@AnchitGupta9) This pic helped change the air war over Kargil. An IAF MiG-25 Foxbat took it in the third week of June 1999. And there is a reason to tell that story today. On 17 Aug 1981, 45 years ago, No. 102 Sqn was raised, beginning the MiG-25’s career in the IAF. 18 years later, the Foxbat was called upon to solve one of the most critical problems confronting the IAF in Kargil: accurately finding targets. It is also an important part of Safed Sagar that @NetflixIndia largely ignored. Identifying Pakistani positions and fixing their precise coordinates had become a serious problem. The Army’s maps were dated and inadequate for extracting accurate coordinates. Newer Survey of India maps would only reach the troops towards the end of June. The IAF therefore needed vertical aerial photography. It had the Avro 748, Jaguar, Canberra and MiG-25 available, but each had limitations. The Avro was unsuitable for a hostile environment. Jaguars with Vicon cameras produced excellent low-level imagery, but operating low over Kargil meant exposure to SAMs. A No. 106 Sqn Canberra had already been struck by an Anza missile on its first reconnaissance sortie. That left the MiG-25. The Foxbat normally operated above 20 km at around Mach 2.4. Its 72-inch focal-length cameras offered enormous photographic coverage, while its Peleng-DM navigation system could associate accurate positional information with the imagery. But at its normal altitude, the resolution was insufficient to identify small bunkers, sangars and concealed positions in Kargil. The Foxbat had to come down. At around 8 km, the imagery was superb, but the aircraft would be dangerously exposed to shoulder-fired missiles. A 13–14 km profile offered greater safety, but required minimum reheat and pushed the aircraft to about Mach 1.3. The eventual compromise was remarkable for a Foxbat: around 10 km and Mach 0.9. It gave roughly 5 km of vertical separation from the missile belts while allowing an effective fighter escort. The MiG-25 had no RWR, flares or chaff. Two MiG-29s provided top cover, with two Mirage 2000s accompanying it. If seriously threatened, the escape plan was pure Foxbat: maximum afterburner, climb to 20 km, accelerate to Mach 2.4 and get out. Navigation accuracy was equally critical. The Peleng-DM, like any inertial system, could drift. Its feed was integrated with the RSBN beacon system, and Wg Cdr P.J. Thakur went a step further, borrowing a handheld GPS from No. 7 Sqn to verify that the positions being generated were accurate. The MiG-25 was ferried to Adampur on 18 June. Weather ruled out operations on 19 and 20 June. On 21 June 1999, Wg Cdr P.J. Thakur flew the first operational photo-reconnaissance mission over the Drass–Kargil sector. Mirage 2000s flown by Wg Cdr S. Chhabra and Wg Cdr Rohit Verma accompanied the mission, while MiG-29s led by Wg Cdr S. Harpal Singh provided top cover. Two Pakistani F-16s approached during the photographic run. The MiG-29s deterred them, and the Foxbat stayed on task. The exposed film was then flown back to Bareilly for processing. When the photographs reached Western Air Command and Air HQ, the impact was evident. Tololing. Muntho Dhalo. Tiger Hill. Positions that had been difficult to locate with confidence were now clearly visible. Enlargements revealed bunkers, sangars and camouflaged positions. Crucially, the imagery could be tied to accurate coordinates. Strike crews could now study their targets before take-off, see how they would appear from release height, fix their coordinates and plan the direction of attack. Look again at the photograph. In the Kargil mountains, where locating a small position could be almost as difficult as attacking it, imagery of this quality mattered enormously. The MiG-25 went on to fly four more missions over Kargil–Drass, besides reconnaissance over Rajouri–Poonch and a sortie to establish the situation around Gultari. The Foxbat is remembered for Mach 2.4 and the stratosphere. Over Kargil, it made a critical contribution by doing almost the opposite: coming down to 10 km and slowing to Mach 0.9 so its cameras could see what mattered. We held a meeting with H.E. Masashi Nakagome, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Japan to Ukraine @JPEmbUA. I expressed my gratitude for Japan’s unwavering support for Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, as well as for the substantial practical assistance provided, in particular, to Ukraine’s energy sector. Through the Ministry of Energy’s hubs alone, Ukraine has received more than 113 tonnes of humanitarian aid, including 259 backup power units. Our partners provided assistance under various support programmes, including two gas turbines and mobile substations, 181 generators, 118 transformers, 6,400 gabions, and other essential equipment. We look forward to continued cooperation as Ukraine prepares for the 2026/2027 heating season, as russia continues its targeted attacks on our energy and gas infrastructure. We discussed the need to accelerate the procurement, with JICA’s @JICA_direct_en support, of 62 power transformers for frontline regions. One such transformer has already been delivered to the Kherson region, with another 27 supplied to the Mykolaiv region. Together with our Japanese partners, we are also working on procuring specialised equipment for gas production. We are equally interested in exploring opportunities for cooperation on the restoration and modernisation of Ukraine’s thermal power plants (TPPs) and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) during 2027-2030. We deeply value Japan’s support and our partners’ readiness to continue our cooperation in strengthening Ukraine’s energy resilience. Armed clashes erupted in and around Baidoa town, South-West state, Somalia, this morning. Dr Elshafie Mohammed, our country representative in Somalia, provides an update ⬇️ “At Bay Regional hospital, where we work in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, teams received 71 wounded people, including women and children. Four deaths were recorded, including one young woman. Patients continue to arrive, and these figures are expected to rise. “Baidoa hosts more than half a million people displaced by conflict, drought and insecurity, many of whom depend on the town’s already limited health services. These services are stretched beyond capacity. Each new cycle of violence places further pressure on the health system and pushes lifesaving care further out of reach for those who need it. “It is devastating to see civilians caught up in violence again. Civilians, health facilities, and medical staff must be protected, and wounded people must be able to reach medical care safely. “At Bay Regional hospital, MSF supports the emergency, maternity, paediatrics, nutrition, and outpatient departments.”

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta today launched ‘Delhi Ko Kude Se Azadi Swachhta Abhiyan 2026’, a city-wide campaign from 17 August to 2 October. Government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens will join hands for cleanliness drives across public spaces, with a focus on Shramdaan, waste segregation, reducing single-use plastic and the 3R principle of Reduce, Reuse and Recycle. महाराष्ट्र में ऑटो-टैक्सी वालों को मराठी सीखने की डेडलाइन खत्म, अब बोलना ही होगा... कुठे जायचं साहेब? महाराष्ट्र में ऑटो-रिक्शा और टैक्सी चलाने वाले गैर-मराठी ड्राइवरों के लिए दी गई 105 दिन की मोहलत खत्म हो गई है. अब 18 अगस्त से परिवहन विभाग ऐसे ड्राइवरों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई शुरू करेगा, जिन्हें कामचलाऊ मराठी भी नहीं आती. नियम नहीं मानने पर ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस सस्पेंड होने से लेकर हमेशा के लिए रद्द तक हो सकता है. महाराष्ट्र के परिवहन मंत्री प्रताप सरनाईक ने सोमवार को कहा कि ड्राइवरों को मराठी का बुनियादी ज्ञान देने के लिए 1 मई से 15 अगस्त तक 105 दिन का समय दिया गया था. यह समय-सीमा अब खत्म हो चुकी है.समाचार एजेंसी के मुताबिक परिवहन विभाग जांच के दौरान यह देखेगा कि ऑटो और टैक्सी ड्राइवरों को रोजमर्रा के काम के लिए जरूरी मराठी आती है या नहीं. अगर किसी ड्राइवर को बुनियादी मराठी नहीं आती, तो उसे तुरंत लाइसेंस रद्द करने के बजाय पहले एक महीने का नोटिस दिया जाएगा. इस दौरान ड्राइवर को मराठी सीखकर अपनी दक्षता साबित करनी होगी. अगर एक महीने में मराठी सीख ली तो लाइसेंस चलता रहेगा. अगर नोटिस खत्म होने के बाद भी ड्राइवर जरूरी मराठी नहीं सीख पाता है तो उसका लाइसेंस तीन महीने के लिए सस्पेंड किया जा सकता है. तीन महीने के सस्पेंशन के बाद भी नियमों का पालन नहीं करने पर लाइसेंस हमेशा के लिए रद्द किया जा सकता है. इसका साफ मलतब है कि ड्राइवरों को 'कुठे जायचं साहेब?' यानी आपको कहां जाना है, मराठी में ही बोलना होगा. . . परिवहन मंत्री के मुताबिक महाराष्ट्र में ड्राइवरों के लिए मराठी की दक्षता से जुड़ा कानून 1989 से ही मौजूद है. हालांकि इसे लंबे समय से प्रभावी तरीके से लागू नहीं किया गया. सरनाईक ने कहा कि उन्होंने इस नियम को सख्ती से लागू करने का फैसला किया है ताकि राज्य में गाड़ी चलाने वाले ड्राइवरों को मराठी का कामकाजी ज्ञान हो. सरकार ने ड्राइवरों को मराठी सिखाने के लिए खास तैयारी भी की. परिवहन विभाग ने कोंकण मराठी साहित्य परिषद और मुंबई मराठी साहित्य संघ जैसे संगठनों के साथ मिलकर पढ़ने की सामग्री तैयार की. ड्राइवरों के लिए चार पेज की एक पुस्तिका तैयार की गई, जिसमें रोजमर्रा के परिवहन काम में इस्तेमाल होने वाले करीब 18 से 20 जरूरी मराठी वाक्य शामिल हैं. सरकार के मुताबिक राज्य में 160 सक्रिय शाखाओं और करीब 1600 प्रशिक्षकों के नेटवर्क के जरिए 11 लाख से ज्यादा ड्राइवरों को प्रशिक्षण दिया गया है. ट्रेनिंग पूरी करने वाले ड्राइवरों को QR कोड से सत्यापित सर्टिफिकेट भी दिए जाएंगे. मराठी की जांच सिर्फ अभी होने वाली कार्रवाई तक सीमित नहीं रहेगी. परिवहन मंत्री ने कहा कि ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस के नियमित रिन्यूअल के दौरान भी भाषा की जानकारी की जांच अनिवार्य होगी. सरकार के इस फैसले का ऑटो और टैक्सी यूनियनों की ओर से शुरुआती विरोध हुआ था. इसके बाद सरकार ने यूनियन नेताओं और अन्य प्रतिनिधियों से बातचीत की और ड्राइवरों को तैयारी के लिए 105 दिन का समय दिया. अब यह समय पूरा हो चुका है. मंत्री प्रताप सरनाईक ने साफ कहा है कि 18 अगस्त से कार्रवाई शुरू होगी और सरकार अपने फैसले से पीछे नहीं हटेगी. #Maharashtra #Auto #Marathi #MarathiLanguage

Again…logistics at sea is both interesting and sexy, and has been for thousands of years. Brian Roemmele (@BrianRoemmele) Why the Romans gave their amphorae pointed bottoms It looks like a design mistake at first glance. Or they were too dumb to understand flat. Why make a heavy clay vessel that cannot stand on its own when a flat bottom would seem so much more practical? The Romans (and the Greeks before them) were solving a different problem. Amphorae were the shipping containers of the ancient Mediterranean. They carried wine, olive oil, fish sauce, and other liquids across open water in quantities that would make a modern logistics manager envious. The material was ceramic—strong under compression, but brittle and unforgiving when dropped or slammed against a dock. A flat-bottomed jar carries a fatal flaw: the sharp angle where the base meets the wall. That rim is a stress concentrator. One hard impact and the vessel cracks. After enough expensive losses, shippers discovered that a narrow, massively thickened point eliminated the weak edge entirely. The thick tip could take punishment that would destroy a conventional base. The long twin handles were equally purposeful. A dockworker could pass a heavy amphora from one hand to the other without setting it down. The same handles became ready-made tie-down points once the cargo was aboard. And when the vessel was laid on its side, the handles stopped it from rolling. The pointed base delivered the final advantages. A full amphora was heavy; the point let a man drag it across the quay instead of lifting its entire weight. In the hold, the geometry became brilliant: each pointed tip nestled into the space between the necks of the amphorae below it. The result was a dense, interlocking lattice that wasted almost no volume. What looks unstable on dry land was, at sea, a remarkably efficient system—rugged, space-saving, and perfectly adapted to the brutal realities of ancient trade. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/BrianRoemmele/status/2089369451636601195#m

"The U.S. Treasury has the legal ability to intervene in the foreign exchange market, but in the last few decades it has generally refrained from intervention," writes CFR's @Brad_Setser. "The main benefit of this operation is likely that it stops—at least for a while—the risk of a potentially disruptive further depreciation of the yen. A weak yen tends to put pressure on other Asian currencies, and it could make it harder for China to continue to allow a slow appreciation of its currency." "Ultimately, reestablishing a credible intervention threat and a series of rate hikes should stabilize the yen. It is really very weak, and it has overshot Japan's underlying fundamentals," argues Setser.

Mohebbi said diplomacy falls under Iran's Foreign Ministry, which also denies any current talks with the U.S. "due to the broken promises and dark experiences that exist from the repeated and constant U.S. violation of promises." The IRGC spokesman said Trump "is trying to temporarily control the price of oil and energy in the world with these statements, but he has only one real way forward, and that is to accept defeat and implement the conditions set by Iran."

اسلام آباد: 17 اگست 2026۔ وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت نیشنل انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی بورڈ میں جاری اصلاحات اور اسلام آباد ٹیکنالوجی پارک کی تعمیر کی پیشرفت کے حوالے سے جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. وزیراعظم نے نیشنل انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی بورڈ کو شہریوں کے لیے آسان، مؤثر اور جدید ڈیجیٹل خدمات کی فراہمی پر خصوصی توجہ دینے کی ہدایت کی. وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ شہریوں کو بروقت، شفاف اور آسان ڈیجیٹل خدمات کی فراہمی کے لیے تمام متعلقہ ادارے مربوط انداز میں کام کریں. شہریوں کو سرکاری خدمات کے حصول میں سہولت فراہم کرنا حکومت کی ترجیح ہے. وزیراعظم نے تمام سرکاری ڈیجیٹل پلیٹ فارمز کو ہم عصر تقاضوں کے مطابق مزید مؤثر بنانے کی ہدایت کی. وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ آئی ٹی اور ڈیجیٹل اصلاحات میں وفاقی وزارتوں کی ای آفس پر منتقلی اب تک کی اہم ترین اصلاحات میں سے ہے. وزیراعظم نے وفاقی حکومت کی تمام ماتحت اداروں اور ایس او ایز میں ای آفس کا استعمال یقینی بنانے، سرکاری اداروں کی ڈیجیٹلائزیشن کے عمل کو تیز کرنے اور جدید ٹیکنالوجی سے بھرپور استفادہ حاصل کرنے اور تمام سرکاری املاک کی ریکارڈ کی ڈیجیٹائزیشن جلد از جلد مکمل کرنے کی ہدایت کی. وزیراعظم نے اسلام آباد ٹیکنالوجی پارک کی تکمیل میں تاخیر پر برہمی کا اظہار کیا. وزیراعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ اسلام آباد ٹیکنالوجی پارک کی تعمیر کو جلد از جلد مکمل کرنے اور ٹیکنالوجی پارک کو ترجیحی بنیادوں پر فعال کیا جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ اسلام آباد ٹیکنالوجی پارک کو چلانے کیلئے مکمل طور پر آوٹ سورس کیا جائے. اجلاس کو بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ این آئی ٹی بی کی رائٹ سائیزنگ کی جا چکی ہے اور اہم عہدوں پر تعیناتی ایک شفاف طریقے سے کی جارہی ہے. تمام وفاقی وزارتیں ای آفس پر منتقل ہو چکی ہیں جبکہ دیگر محکموں اور سرکاری ملکیتی اداروں میں اس کی ترویج پر کام جاری ہے. اجلاس میں اسلام آباد ٹیکنالوجی پارک کی تعمیر پر پیشرفت کے حوالے سے بھی بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء احسن اقبال، احد خان چیمہ، ڈاکٹر مصدق مسعود ملک، شزا فاطمہ خواجہ اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

यह एक ऐसी पुस्तक है, जिसे हम सभी को एक बार जरूर पढ़ना चाहिए। इससे हमें सीखने को मिलेगा कि जीवन में सही दिशा और निरंतर प्रयास के साथ कैसे आगे बढ़ा जा सकता है। सामान्यतः आज की युवा पीढ़ी सफलता का सरल और त्वरित रास्ता तलाशती है, ऐसा रास्ता, जो तुरंत मंजिल तक पहुंचा दे। लेकिन वेंकैया जी ने कभी आसान रास्ता नहीं चुना। उन्होंने सही और कठिन रास्ते को अपनाया और अपने संघर्ष, समर्पण और निरंतर परिश्रम से भारतीय जनता पार्टी को एक मुकाम तक पहुंचाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। इसलिए आज की युवा पीढ़ी को यह समझना चाहिए कि राजनीति हो या जीवन, शॉर्टकट से नहीं, बल्कि लंबे संघर्ष, धैर्य और निरंतर प्रयास से ही स्थायी सफलता हासिल होती है। -श्री @NitinNabin

स्मृति ईरानी का राजनीति से वनवास खत्म! बीजेपी में मिली बड़ी जिम्मेदारी; जानें यूपी चुनाव के लिए कितनी फिट नई भूमिका? अमेठी से राहुल गांधी के खिलाफ 2014 और फिर 2024 में कांग्रेस के किशोरी लाल शर्मा ने उन्हें अमेठी में 1.67 लाख से ज्यादा वोटों के अंतर से हरा दिया. इसके बावजूद यूपी की राजनीति में स्मृति ईरानी का प्रभाव और पहचान बरकरार रही, कभी टीवी की दुनिया में 'तुलसी' के किरदार से घर-घर में पहचान बनाने वाली स्मृति ईरानी अब एक बार फिर बीजेपी की केंद्रीय संगठनात्मक टीम का अहम हिस्सा बन गई हैं. अभिनेत्री से राजनेता बनीं स्मृति ईरानी को बीजेपी ने राष्ट्रीय महासचिव की जिम्मेदारी दी है. करीब दो साल पहले मोदी सरकार से बाहर होने और 2024 का लोकसभा चुनाव अमेठी से हारने के बाद उनकी संगठन में यह वापसी राजनीतिक तौर पर बेहद महत्वपूर्ण मानी जा रही है. . . बीजेपी की नई टीम में स्मृति ईरानी के साथ सुनील बंसल, विनोद तावड़े, बिप्लब देब और सतीश पूनिया जैसे अनुभवी नेताओं को भी महत्वपूर्ण जिम्मेदारियां मिली हैं. इससे संकेत साफ है कि पार्टी अब 2027 के विधानसभा चुनावों को लेकर चुनावी मोड में आ चुकी है. बीजेपी के लिए 2027 का उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव बेहद अहम है. 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में पार्टी को यूपी में बड़ा झटका लगा था. बीजेपी 80 में से 33 सीटों पर सिमट गई, जबकि विपक्षी इंडिया गठबंधन ने 43 सीटें जीतकर बीजेपी के सामने बड़ी चुनौती पेश की. ऐसे में विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले पार्टी को संगठन को फिर से मजबूत करने, कार्यकर्ताओं को सक्रिय करने और अलग-अलग सामाजिक वर्गों के बीच अपनी पकड़ मजबूत करने की जरूरत है. स्मृति ईरानी की नई भूमिका इसी रणनीति का हिस्सा मानी जा रही है. #SmritiIrani #UttarPradesh #BJP

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta today launched ‘Delhi Ko Kude Se Azadi Swachhta Abhiyan 2026’, a city-wide campaign from 17 August to 2 October. Government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens will join hands for cleanliness drives across public spaces, with a focus on Shramdaan, waste segregation, reducing single-use plastic and the 3R principle of Reduce, Reuse and Recycle. The best-performing wards will also receive an incentive of ₹1 crore for outstanding cleanliness efforts. The Delhi Government appeals to every citizen to come forward, contribute through Shramdaan and make cleanliness a part of everyday life. Delhi BJP President and Union Minister of State Shri Harsh Malhotra, Cabinet Minister Shri Ashish Sood, MCD Mayor Shri Pravesh Wahi, MLA Shri Abhay Verma and other dignitaries were present on the occasion. @hdmalhotra @ashishsood_bjp @praveshwahi @abhayvermabjp #DelhiKoKoodeSeAzadi

The Wall Street Journal reports that Iran’s leadership used the period following the June memorandum of understanding not to prepare for deescalation, but for a larger conflict with the United States. According to Iranian and Arab officials and intercepted communications cited by the Journal, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has expanded its control over Iran’s military, accelerated missile and drone production, and worked with allied groups in Iraq and Yemen to broaden the battlefield. That has included positioning missiles, naval weapons and drones around the Red Sea, providing Houthi forces with intelligence and target information, and preparing attacks against Saudi ports and energy infrastructure. Iranian-backed militias in Iraq have also targeted Saudi energy sites. The Journal also reports a broader shift inside Tehran toward an offensive posture. Recent senior security appointments have strengthened IRGC control over the regular military, while commanders have publicly called for operations against targets in countries hosting U.S. forces. The immediate effect has been a widening conflict: attacks on shipping in Hormuz, strikes against U.S. forces in Jordan and elsewhere, and increasing pressure on Gulf energy infrastructure.

QUISO JUGAR A LAS GUERRITAS CON ESTADOS UNIDOS… PUES YA LO LOGRÓ La presidente Claudia @Claudiashein decidió convertir la revocación de la visa de Andy López Beltrán en un pleito político con Estados Unidos. Salió a defender al hijo de su mentor, gritó “soberanía”, acusó de “injerencia” y pretendió hacer creer a los mexicanos que una decisión de Estados Unidos sobre quién puede entrar a SU territorio constituye una afrenta contra México. Mentira. Estados Unidos también es soberano. Una visa estadounidense no es un derecho. Es un privilegio que ese país concede y puede revocar. Y el mensaje desde Washington es todavía más incómodo: el Departamento de Estado ha reiterado que cada decisión de visa es una decisión de seguridad nacional y que busca impedir el ingreso de individuos que amenacen los intereses de Estados Unidos. Entonces, presidente @Claudiashein: Si quería jugar a las guerritas diplomáticas, engañando a los mexicanos con una falsa “injerencia” y poniendo innecesariamente en riesgo la relación con nuestro principal socio comercial por defender la visa de Andy López Beltrán, ya lo logró. Pero tenga mucho cuidado con el pleito que decidió abrir. Porque hasta ahora Estados Unidos se ha negado, por confidencialidad, a revelar públicamente por qué le revocó la visa a Andy. Y después de las visas retiradas a otros políticos mexicanos y de las acciones judiciales estadounidenses contra funcionarios y personajes de la política mexicana, la pregunta se vuelve cada vez más incómoda: ¿QUÉ LE SABE ESTADOS UNIDOS A ANDY LÓPEZ BELTRÁN Y A OTROS PERSONAJES DE MORENA? When NDTV 24x7 was born, round-the-clock television news was itself a revolution. Today, news is everywhere. On television. On your phone. On an app. On YouTube. On social media. On Connected TV. And increasingly, on platforms that are still taking shape. So 24x7 no longer defines who we are. NDTV does. One name. One identity. Across screens, platforms and formats. And with it, a sharper articulation of what we want our journalism to stand for: WHEN IT REALLY MATTERS. Because in a world overflowing with information, the challenge is no longer simply knowing what happened. It is knowing what matters. What does this change? Whose lives will it affect? Why does it matter? We build from more than three decades of trust and journalistic legacy — but with our eyes firmly on the future. A new look. A renewed NDTV. होर्मुज संकट से भी नहीं होगा LPG क्राइसिस, सरकार ने खेला बड़ा दांव; इन कंपनियों को मिली बड़ी जिम्मेदारी LPG Supply Crisis: मिडिल ईस्ट में जारी जंग और समुद्री रास्तों पर बन रही दिक्क्त के कारण देश में एलपीजी सप्लाई सिस्टम (LPG Supply System) प्रभावित हुआ है. भारत अपनी जरूरत का अधिकतर हिस्सा आयात करता है. इस आयात में से करीब 90% हिस्सा परंपरागत रूप से मिडिल ईस्ट और स्ट्रेट ऑफ होर्मुज (Strait of Hormuz) के रास्ते आता रहा है. ऐसे में होर्मुज में किसी भी तरह की रुकावट का असर एलपीजी (LPG) की उपलब्धता और डिलीवरी पर पड़ता है. मार्च और अप्रैल में एलपीजी क्राइसिस का सामना करने के बाद केंद्र सरकार ने पब्लिक और प्राइवेट सेक्टर की रिफाइनरियों के लिए एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन से जुड़े टारगेट तय किये हैं. आने वाले समय में एलपीजी को लेकर किसी तरह की परेशानी न हो, इसके लिये सरकार की तरफ से दिये गए आदेश में संकट के समय देश में अधिकतम 63,810 टन एलपीजी का रोजाना प्रोडक्शन करने का टारगेट रखा गया है. यह टारगेट फाइनेंशियल ईयर 2026 में देश के कुल घरेलू एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन के दोगुने से भी ज्यादा है. भारत में हर दिन करीब 91,000 टन एलपीजी की खपत होती है. इस हिसाब से सरकार की तरफ से तय किया गया टारगेट देश की रोजाना खपत का करीब 70% है. सरकार की यह तैयारी तत्काल एलपीजी संकट से निपटने को लेकर नहीं है. सरकार की कोशिश ऐसा सिस्टम बनाने की है, जिसमें भविष्य में दूसरे देशों से एलपीजी की सप्लाई बाधित होने पर घरेलू एलपीजी (LPG) प्रोडक्शन को तेजी से बढ़ाया जा सके और घरेलू ग्राहकों को प्रियोरिटी के आधार पर गैस मुहैया कराई जा सके. . . भारत अपनी कुल एलपीजी जरूरत का 90% मिडिल ईस्ट से आयात करता है. फाइनेंशियल ईयर 2025-26 के दौरान भारत ने करीब 33.2 मिलियन टन एलपीजी (LPG) की खपत की है. इसमें से करीब 13.1 मिलियन टन घरेलू प्रोडक्शन था, जबकि 21.3 मिलियन टन गैस का आयात करना पड़ा था. इस हिसाब से कुल खपत का 64% से ज्यादा हिस्सा आयात से आया. आयात में मिडिल ईस्ट की हिस्सेदारी सबसे ज्यादा रही. जंग से पहले भारत का करीब 90% LPG आयात होर्मुज के जरिये आता था. इसलिए समुद्री मार्ग प्रभावित होने से पूरी घरेलू LPG सप्लाई चेन पर असर पड़ता है. यही कारण है कि सरकार किसी भी संकट के समय में इम्पोर्ट के साथ ही सप्लाई रूट पर निर्भरता को भी कम करना चाहती है. भारत की FY 26 के दौरान एलपीजी की खपत करीब 33.2 मिलियन टन रही. यह औसतन रोजाना करीब 91,000 टन के करीब रही. इसके मुकाबले सरकार की तरफ से तय टारगेट 63,810 टन रोजाना की अधिकतम प्रोडक्शन लिमिट करीब 70% दैनिक औसत खपत के बराबर बैठती है. इसका मतलब यह नहीं हुआ कि भारत अपनी एलपीजी (LPG) जरूरत का 70% हमेशा घरेलू प्रोडक्शन से पूरा करेगा. यह क्राइसिस के समय एक्टिव होने वाला प्रोडक्शन फ्रेमवर्क है. यदि आयात पर अचानक असर पड़ता है तो सरकार के पास पहले से यह विकल्प रहेगा कि किस रिफाइनरी से कितनी एलपीजी उपलब्ध कराई जा सकती है. इसके लिए रिलायंस को सबसे ज्यादा एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन का टारगेट मिला है. #LPG #LPGCrisis

How can fisheries and aquaculture create more jobs, better incomes and stronger food systems? Small-scale fisheries and aquaculture already support 600 million people and account for nearly 40% of global capture fisheries production. Since 2010, IFAD has invested over US$2.1 billion in the sector through an integrated approach that links production, value chain development, and enabling policy and institutional frameworks. The result? About 21 million people – primarily small-scale fishers, fish farmers, processors, distributors and retailers – have participated in IFAD-supported projects. Across the portfolio, combined investments in sustainable resource management, post-harvest infrastructure and market linkages show how a value chain-oriented approach can deliver results. In Djibouti, for example, PRAREV-Pêche reached nearly 30,000 people in climate-vulnerable coastal communities. Among participants involved for more than one year, the project contributed to: ✅ 32% higher household incomes ✅ 36% higher revenues from fish sales ✅ 35% lower food insecurity scores Read more about IFAD’s work on small-scale fisheries and aquaculture at ifad.org/en/w/publications/t…

His name is Mohammad Ghmeira. Don’t let them bury it with him. Mohammad Hussam al-Din Ghmeira walked into Haffa police station in Latakia, Syria, over a “routine” money complaint. He left in a coma. Today he left in a coffin. He was a hemophiliac, his blood doesn’t clot. His family told the officers, and asked them not to beat him. They beat him anyway. His father, Hussam Ghmeira, died in Ghouta fighting Assad. The son survived Assad, joined @SyriaCivilDef, only to die in the holding cell of a post-Assad Syrian police station. The uniform changed. The table didn’t. The broken body didn’t. The word “investigation” as a reason to die didn’t. He entered conscious and in stable health. He came out bleeding, then no speech, then acute brain hemorrhage, then a heart that stopped three times. A healthy man does not bleed into his skull in custody by accident. And Ghmeira is not alone. The Syrian Network for Human Rights @snhr documented at least 32 people dead under torture in Syria in 2025, and at least 1,108 arbitrary arrests and detentions across the country in the same year. Different jailers, different flags, same cell, same bruises, same silence afterward. Seven officers detained. The Interior Minister @Anas_Khattab_sy sent condolences and promised accountability. Syria has heard “an investigation has been opened” for eighteen months, and not one public trial. An investigation with no verdict is a burial for the case, not justice for the dead. We don’t want condolences. We want the officers’ names, a public courtroom, and an independent autopsy. The men who ran the old dungeons are gone. The dungeons are still full. The new Syria isn’t judged by its statements, it’s judged by whether Mohammad (or any other detainee) can die in a police cell and anyone answers for it.

In rural Morocco, cooperatives are turning saffron into a driver of local transformation, capturing more value, creating jobs and keeping economic activity in the community. Through a partnership between IFAD and the Government of Morocco, saffron cultivation was introduced to the Azilal region and supported through several cooperatives working with local farmers. Among them, the Ait Bouali cooperative has brought together 184 farmers and helped build a local enterprise that employs dozens of people year-round. What began with just 17 hectares has expanded to more than 300 hectares, generating up to US$2,500 per hectare, far beyond what traditional crops could offer. The project also delivered measurable results across the region, with local incomes increasing by nearly 24%, poverty falling by 18% and almost 70% of supported farms boosting productivity by 20% or more. By supporting cooperatives and local value chains, IFAD and the Government of Morocco enabled small-scale producers to move into higher-value markets while creating employment and broader benefits for rural communities. The cost of servicing US debt is the highest in decades: On Thursday, the US government sold $25 billion of 30Y Treasury bonds at a 5.216% yield, the highest auction yield since 2001. This follows a $42 billion auction of 10Y Treasury notes on Wednesday that resulted in a 4.683% yield, the highest since 2007. Previously, on July 9th, the government sold 30Y Treasury bonds at a 5.058% yield, the highest since 2007, highlighting the worsening trend in US debt financing costs. By comparison, yields on the same-maturity Treasury auctions were below 2.00% during the 2020 pandemic. This comes as investors are demanding more compensation to finance the US government's ever-growing deficit. In July, the US Treasury’s budget deficit surged +$141 billion YoY, to $432 billion, the largest July total in history. The US debt crisis is entering uncharted territory.

1. Gen. Douglas MacArthur immortalised the line ‘old soldiers never die, they just fade away’. Last week, an Indian soldier, among the greatest & most decorated, personified this irony. The 40th anniversary of his assassination passed unnoticed. No commemoration, no memorials, not even a tweet from the ever-so-active Army handles. It’s as if there was a ‘corporate’ call to erase all memory of Gen. AS Vaidya. It should raise questions. #NationalInterest 2. Gen. Vaidya was one among only 6 Indians to be awarded 2 MVCs, earned in the most intense battlefields, 1965 & 1971. He rose to be India’s 13th Army chief. He retired on 31 January, 1986, & yet died in the line of duty on 10 August that year as 2 assassins shot him at the wheel of his Maruti 800 in Pune. 3. Soldiers, however senior, can’t determine their destinies, & especially so in democracies. Punjab deteriorated & although the Army had nothing to do with law & order there, responsibility for clearing the Golden Temple fell on Vaidya’s shoulders. Sikh militants drew up hit lists. Gen. Vaidya’s name was on it. 4. Two assassins from ‘Khalistan Commando Force’ were closing in on Vaidya. And yet nobody, not the intelligence, Maharashtra police or even the Army showed awareness that their recently-retired chief was still completing his home in Pune’s Koregaon Park. His security had been left to Pune police. So callous was this that all Vaidya was given was a solitary police gunman. 5. Constable Ramchandra Kshirsagar was in the backseat of the Maruti as the assassins pulled along on an Ind-Suzuki motorcycle & shot Vaidya in the head. Kshirsagar, dazed, tried to get out of the car, but his foot got caught in the door & he was dragged for a bit. India’s greatest war hero was abandoned. 6. Vaidya was warned multiple times of the threat to his life. He was philosophical. “I fought two wars & came out without a scratch, & if a bullet has my name on it, it will find me.” Did our “system” fail him in making the assassins’ task so easy? And did it fail him yet again this week? Should all old soldiers, even your greatest war heroes, be made to fade away into anonymity like Vaidya? It’s a question also for the Army as an institution. 7. Read #NationalInterest:theprint.in/national-interes… Watch #NationalInterest: ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=SrEfEHts…

When you do a write up you write the logical path for the reader to follow your finding. You don’t write the path you took to get there. If a friend asks for a recommendation you don’t list everything you did before you figured it out. IRIS C2 (@C2IRIS) If you are a young vulnerability researcher, it's important to remember this: When people write blog posts or give conference talks on the brilliant multi-bug exploit chains that they discover, they generally talk about it as though they just elegantly pranced from one brilliant insight to another. The reality, of course, is almost always much less elegant, and involved a lot more banging of one's head against the wall to finally stumble into each brilliant insight. But you can't blame people for doing this, because talking about the 1,001 things that didn't work would make the talk or blog post way too long and incomprehensible. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/C2IRIS/status/2088739719777567070#m

The Western military is no longer a reliable fighting force. It is a cargo-cult ritual performed by men who still believe expensive choreography can substitute for the ability to kill and endure. Generals mostly pretend to prepare for the next war in the same way priests recite ancient liturgies. They polish doctrines written for uncontested skies and polite opponents who agreed to die on schedule. The result is a force exquisitely optimized for PowerPoint victories and completely unprepared for an enemy who simply refuses to cooperate with the script. Ukraine exposed the fraud in real time. Billions in “game-changing” systems arrived, performed their brief theater, and were ground down by mass, electronic warfare, and cheap attrition the West had declared obsolete. The Red Sea added the punchline of the most expensive navy in history reduced to frantic, magazine-emptying defense against the military equivalent of bottle rockets. Aircraft carriers were once the floating cathedrals of American power now function as the world’s most expensive hostages, sailing inside missile envelopes their defenders cannot reliably close. Yet the propaganda machine never misses a beat. Destroy a civilian warehouse, a transformer station, a grain silo, and the spokesmen speak of “strategic effects.” Only a civilization that has replaced military judgment with GDP accounting could mistake the demolition of civilian infrastructure for the destruction of an army’s will or capacity. It is expensive vandalism performed by people too risk-averse, too careerist, and too conceptually bankrupt to close with a real opponent. How weak does a power have to become before its primary output is narrative rather than decision? The relics still look impressive in the parade but perhaps not even then. Larkin raised the topic of Israel’s genocide in Gaza, pointing to statements and findings from institutions such as the United Nations, Amnesty International and Israeli human rights organisation B’Tselem. Milberg refused the characterisation, repeatedly claiming that his statements were “factually incorrect.” She also claimed that genocide is a specific legal term and opposed Larkin’s references to UN findings concerning Israel’s war crimes in Gaza. Larkin outlined Israel’s deliberate targeting of civilians, restrictions on humanitarian aid and attacks on churches, schools and other places of worship, before Milberg again interrupted and said his account was “factually not correct.” The exchange was cut short when Milberg said she was being told they had to wrap up the interview. شاید مهم‌ترین سرمایه‌ی نامرئی یک حکومت اقتدارگرا این باور عمومی باشد که مقاومت بی‌فایده است. وقتی مردم حکومتی را شکست‌ناپذیر تصور کنند، حتا فکر مخالفت هم هزینه‌ای سنگین می‌یابد. بخشی از این ترس نه از زور مستقیم، که از همان تصور قدرت مطلق سرچشمه می‌گیرد. جنگ چریکی، حتا در مقیاسی محدود، می‌تواند این تصویر را خدشه‌دار کند. وقتی گروه کوچک برای مدت طولانی در برابر نیرویی بزرگ‌تر دوام می‌آورد، پیامش از میدان جنگ فراتر می‌رود. حکومت آسیب‌پذیر است. بااین‌حال، این اثر هرگز تضمینی نیست. اگر عملیات مسلحانه به تلفات غیرنظامی یا ناامنی گسترده بینجامد، جامعه ممکن است به‌ جای همراهی با مقاومت، از ادامه‌ی جنگ بترسد و فاصله بگیرد. نمونه‌های فراوانی از این الگو در تاریخ جنگ‌های چریکی دیده شده است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259232
